name: HRR_TMPL_ANALYTIC_TYPES_B
description: Talent Review Analytic Types table. This table is used to store different analytic types used in a graph (example, BOX_CHART)

columns.name: ANALYTIC_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Primary key of HRR_TMPL_ANALYTIC_TYPES_B

columns.name: ANALYTIC_VIEW_MODE
columns.description: Defines if box view is XY mode or Single Measure mode

columns.name: METRIC_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the metric to be used for Single measure view

columns.name: DEFAULT_VIEW_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to specify if the current view is the default view

columns.name: SUBMIT_BOX_ASGNMNT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to check if the box labels need to be pushed to Profiles

columns.name: VIEW_ROW_COUNT
columns.description: Specifies the number of rows for the single measure mode

columns.name: VIEW_COLUMN_COUNT
columns.description: Specifies the number of columns for the single measure mode

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS

columns.name: DASHBOARD_TMPL_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key of HRR_DASHBOARD_TMPLS_B

columns.name: ANALYTIC_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of analytic graph.

columns.name: HORIZONTAL_AXIS_CODE
columns.description: Horizontal axis value.

columns.name: VERTICAL_AXIS_CODE
columns.description: Vertical axis value.

columns.name: HORZ_RATING_MODEL_ID
columns.description: Horizontal Rating Model Id

columns.name: VERT_RATING_MODEL_ID
columns.description: Vertical Rating Model Id

columns.name: SCORE_RATING_MODEL_ID
columns.description: Rating model for calibrating talent score.

columns.name: RISK_RATING_MODEL_ID
columns.description: Risk of Loss rating Model Id

columns.name: IMPACT_RATING_MODEL_ID
columns.description: Impact of Loss rating Model Id

columns.name: COLOR_SCHEME_CODE
columns.description: Chart Box Color Scheme

columns.name: DEFAULT_VIEW_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the default view type in dashboard template

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.
